title: Player's wither hunter
description: What if a wither would follow you everywhere you go to kill you?
body:
# EUn wither te persigue a matarte

<hr>

## 📖 Descripcion

Al rato de spawnear en el mundo, un wither spawneara para matarte, este te seguira en largas distancias e incluso entre dimensiones.

## 📖 Description

After spawning in the world, a wither will spawn to kill you, it will follow you over long distances and even between dimensions.
